_comment: GROUND TRUTH for milestone 3. Must NOT be shown to the debugging agent. Experiment ids are deliberately neutral and not in task order.

faults.description: Full flag is generated incorrectly: it asserts when DEPTH-1 entries are stored (off-by-one, wrap bit ignored).
Read pointer advances on rd_en even when the FIFO is empty (pointer update gated by rd_en instead of rd_fire).
Write pointer advances on wr_en even when the FIFO is full (pointer update gated by wr_en instead of wr_fire; storage write still gated).
